summary.text: GRANLI FISKERI AS is a private limited company registered in Nord-Lenangen, founded 2009-06-18. GRANLI FISKERI AS is registered for fishing: catching, processing and selling fish and shellfish, and operating vessels. Its statutory purpose also covers processing and sale of fish and shellfish, operating vessels, other products that naturally go with this, participating in other companies with similar activities, buying and selling shares, and otherwise taking interest in other enterprises. Its main industry code is 03.110: marine fishing. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 58 780 984 NOK and the annual result was 25 358 046 NOK; operating income was up from 30 015 490 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -5 646 922 NOK in 2024 to 25 358 046 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -17 613 952 NOK in 2024 to 7 744 093 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Sten Ragnar Granli (daglig leder and styrets leder). The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
